mapper.select: SELECT c.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_order o WHERE o.class_id = c.class_id AND o.status = 'BOOKED') AS booked_count FROM class_table c WHERE c.class_begin IS NULL OR c.class_begin >= #{now} ORDER BY c.class_begin ASC
SELECT * FROM class_table WHERE coach = #{coach} ORDER BY class_begin DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO class_table (class_name, class_begin, class_time, coach, max_capacity) VALUES (#{className}, #{classBegin}, #{classTime}, #{coach}, #{maxCapacity})
mapper.update: UPDATE class_table SET class_name = #{className}, class_begin = #{classBegin}, class_time = #{classTime}, coach = #{coach}, max_capacity = #{maxCapacity} WHERE class_id = #{classId}
